entry.summary: Finding the ideal human resources translation software is critical to the health of your organization. Here’s why. Intelligent internal communication means that your training materials, newsletters, memos and emails all convey the same exact meaning and tone–regardless of an employee’s native language. For this reason, it’s critical to refrain from relying on pure machine translation for HR. If you do, you’ll sacrifice the quality of your workplace communication. And this can affect working relationships, cause misunderstandings of policies and agreements and may even lead to lawsuits. Generally speaking, it may negatively affect your organization’s morale or culture.
